# Standard-library peer replaying a sanitized pyright 1.1.414 recording.
import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
mode=sys.argv[1];root=Path.cwd().as_uri()
def read():
 length=None
 while True:
  line=sys.stdin.buffer.readline()
  if not line:raise EOFError()
  if line==b'\r\n':break
  if line.lower().startswith(b'content-length:'):length=int(line.split(b':',1)[1])
 return json.loads(sys.stdin.buffer.read(length))
def send(message):
 body=json.dumps(message).encode();sys.stdout.buffer.write(f'Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n\r\n'.encode()+body);sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
if mode=='replay':
 rows=json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'recorded-lsp.json').read_text().replace('file:///FROZEN',root))
 for row in rows:
  if row['direction']=='send':
   item=read()
   # Peer parameters checked by unit Replay; here also exercise real framing.
   if item!=row['message']:raise ValueError(str((item,row['message'])))
  else:send(row['message'])
else:
 item=read()
 if mode=='error':send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':item['id'],'error':{'code':-32603,'message':'recorded error'}})
 elif mode=='config':
  send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':99,'method':'workspace/configuration','params':{'items':[{'section':'python.analysis'},{'section':'missing.value'}]}})
  response=read();assert response['result']==[{'x':1},{}]
  send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':100,'method':'client/registerCapability','params':{}});assert read()['result'] is None
  send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'window/logMessage','params':{'message':'notification'}})
  send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':12345,'result':'late'})
  send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':item['id'],'result':'ok'})
 elif mode=='bad_length':sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'Content-Length: -1\r\n\r\n');sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
 elif mode=='missing_length':sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'Content-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n');sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
 elif mode=='truncated':sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'Content-Length: 100\r\n\r\n{}');sys.stdout.buffer.flush();sys.exit()
 elif mode=='malformed':sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'Content-Length: 2\r\n\r\nxx');sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
 elif mode=='eof':sys.exit()
 elif mode in ('timeout','stubborn'):
  if mode=='stubborn':
   import signal
   signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
  time.sleep(30)
 # Respond to shutdown, apart from intentionally unresponsive variants.
 try:
  shutdown=read();send({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':shutdown['id'],'result':None});read()
 except EOFError:pass
